captions.detailed: A professional DSLR camera flash accessory featuring a black body with a tall rear control panel, a metal mounting hot-shoe foot at the base, and a forward-facing flash head. The flash head is held between a pair of short yoke arms and features a light-gray rectangular lens on the front, along with a thin white bounce card that slides vertically out of a slot on the top of the head. The head can swivel horizontally relative to the base body, tilt vertically between the yoke arms, and the bounce card slides prismatically up and down.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a professional DSLR camera flash. It must include a main vertical body with a metal mounting foot, a yoke that swivels on a vertical revolute joint, a forward-facing flash head that tilts on a horizontal revolute joint between the yoke arms, and a white bounce card that slides prismatically from a slot in the top of the head.
captions.factory: The model is built using four main parts: a base, a yoke, a head, and a bounce card. The base is constructed from a filleted box for the main body, a thin box for the foot, and a cylinder for the swivel neck. The yoke is made from a central cylinder and two vertical rectangular arms. The head is a hollowed box with a front-facing lens and a top slot. The bounce card is a thin rectangular plate. These parts are connected with a vertical revolute joint between the base and yoke, a horizontal revolute joint between the yoke and head, and a prismatic joint for the bounce card.
